title: Assistant Professor of Education
bio: Ying Xu's research stands at the intersection of education, psychology, and human-computer interaction, focusing on the design and evaluation of technologies that promote language and literacy development, STEM learning, and wellbeing for children and families.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
